{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "Overall Rating",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "crew_service_quality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Well-separated, interpretable categories (attentive_warm, inattentive_robotic, professional_neutral, rude_hostile) that capture a review theme distinct from the numeric focus and can be segmented against Overall Rating."
    },
    {
      "name": "service_consistency",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean three-way split (consistent_high, consistently_poor, variable_mixed) offers an interpretable associational dimension for comparing ratings."
    },
    {
      "name": "food_quality",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Ordered, interpretable categories (excellent/acceptable/poor_bland) with reasonable spread; nulls present but categories remain comparable against the focus."
    },
    {
      "name": "special_meal_fulfillment",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Boolean is extremely imbalanced (17 true vs 883 false), making it near-constant; too few positive cases to draw a meaningful comparison with Overall Rating."
    },
    {
      "name": "seat_comfort_condition",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Distinct, interpretable comfort categories that map to a review theme and can be segmented, though heavy nulls weaken coverage."
    },
    {
      "name": "cabin_class_expectation_gap",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable expectation-gap tiers that are especially aligned with the query's Class dimension and support informative rating comparisons."
    },
    {
      "name": "service_amenity_cuts",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Highly imbalanced boolean (79 true vs 821 false); limited but not trivial, yet the near-constant distribution restricts segmentation power."
    },
    {
      "name": "service_decline_perception",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Boolean with 106 true cases; interpretable theme with enough minority mass to compare rating distributions, though imbalance limits it."
    },
    {
      "name": "value_for_money_perception",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Categories are interpretable, but this largely restates the existing 'Value For Money' column and correlates tightly with Overall Rating, adding little external associational information."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "As a set, most added columns provide interpretable, well-separated categorical themes (crew service, consistency, food, seat condition, expectation gap) that segment cleanly and support discovering informative relationships with Overall Rating, directly serving the query's theme-vs-rating exploration. Weaknesses lower the score: two booleans (special_meal_fulfillment, service_amenity_cuts) are so imbalanced they enable little comparison, and value_for_money_perception essentially restates an existing column highly collinear with the focus. Overall the set is genuinely EDA-oriented rather than opaque feature engineering, but redundancy and near-constant booleans keep it from being fully informative."
}
